rationale: Record that a CI install-path change crosses the visual-proof-harness selector without touching anything that family is about. The build workflow now installs the motion visual-analysis wheels from tools/motion/visual/requirements.lock, a hash-pinned resolution of the unchanged requirements.txt, under --require-hashes, preferring a read-only tartci host wheelhouse when a gate guest declares one and otherwise retrying the index three times. The selector is crossed by tools/motion/visual/requirements.lock and tools/scripts/test_visual_python_deps_step.py under tools/**/*visual*, and by nothing else. The installed versions equal what the ranges already resolved to on every leg (numpy 2.5.3, Pillow 12.3.0, scikit-image 0.26.0 and their closure). No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold, packaging artifact or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
